Canonical Architecture Runtime

The compact runtime spine remains the controlling baseline. The expanded 𝓝 / ♥ / ξ / Ω / μ / κ notation is a schema-light register bridge over that spine; together they are the baseline register formalism, not a second public runtime. It matters only where it governs or clarifies actual IR, owner/TTP selection, hold/release, collapse radius, burden landing, state reread, PARTIAL, anti-symbol-theater, or restoration. Hard schema fields remain blocked unless a deliberate schema/checker/fixture/smoke migration updates producers, consumers, tests, examples, docs, generated runtime, and release claims. This page is a diagnostic navigation aid; repo runtime/source files remain the source of truth.

NLA boundary: NLA means Natural Language Autoencoder: a reconstruction-fidelity frame for encoding a natural-language discourse state into a controlled intermediate representation and reconstructing it while preserving burdens, registers, source-status, and dependency structure. The AV / activation verbalizer analogue is Layer A / Diagnostic IR / noetic-field banner. The AR / activation reconstructor analogue is reconstruction/reread through R(H,Δ). Reconstruction fidelity asks whether selected/held N, live registers, burdens, owner/TTP eligibility, κ/H, and closure state can be recovered; confabulation, excessive expressivity, lack of grounding, degenerate bottleneck, or reconstruction failure forces PARTIAL/RECURSE or checker failure.

Delta and field diagnostics: Delta-nB and Delta-kappa are event-local transition operators. ∇· / divergence and ∇× / curl are field diagnostics over Delta-produced burden/dependency state. Default output may use compact governance markers such as ∇·κ: positive/live or ∇×κ: unresolved loop only when tied to dependency pressure, loop-breaking, R(H,Δ), or PARTIAL/RECURSE/COMPLETE; long formalism exposition remains audit/formalism-only.

Gradient, closure, and coupling: plain ∇ reads route-gradient pressure among eligible live routes after gate/catalogue constraints; LoopBreak(∇×T) is a licensed loop-breaking submove, not arbitrary assertion; 𝒞(Ψᴺ) is positive closure-field condition over the agent execution field; T_lang: Ψᴺ ⇢ Ψᴵ names the public/restorative output boundary without claiming guaranteed uptake.

Package boundary: atomics/skill/** is tracked canonical source, skill/** is ignored generated runtime, CI/local build compiles atomics into generated skill/**, release .skill packages generated runtime, and raw atomics are not packaged.

Architecture Thesis

This tab is the canonical architecture map. It is not the README, the theory paper, the owner inventory, the case library, the proof ledger, or the docs browser.

What it is

A governed diagnostic runtime: read the live noetic burden before answering, route through the owner/TTP that can change state, then release only after reread.

What carries weight

Diagnostic State / IR, routing precedence, owner selection, target → operation → result, Land(ⁿB), field diagnostics, state reread, and stop/hold/recurse/partial discipline.

What it is not

Not a topic-to-answer lookup, argument bank, school-label router, public proof ledger, release checklist, or notation showcase.

Source of truth

atomics/skill/ is tracked canonical source. skill/ is ignored generated runtime. This page explains boundaries; it does not own runtime behavior.
